purpose: Test the hash-bound minimal-v3-stock-ns controlled package with the fixed Toybox probe and prove independent stock recovery.

classification.basis: The candidate completed all management checks, entered Linux /init, registered VMBus storage and VSOCK, and processed the host initial-configuration message. mini_init rejected that message before any ext4 distro mount; the Toybox CreateInstance call returned E_ABORT. Trace evidence therefore directly supports B2 but not B3. The exact excluded initial-configuration field remains unresolved.

traceAnalysis.earliestBlocker: mini_init ProcessMessage rejected the initial configuration before an ext4 distro mount

decision: Finalize minimal-v3-stock-ns at B2 with an unresolved initial-configuration policy blocker. Do not rerun this byte-identical candidate. Inspect the retained host configuration and mini_init fail-closed predicate to select one source change, while preserving the accepted probe and recovery contract.
